verdict: A solid zone-2 ride with one honest climb — the fade at the end is worth fixing with food, not fitness.

intent.why: No ride was scheduled; 90 minutes mostly in zone 2 reads as an endurance ride.

execution.summary: Steady and well paced until the last half hour, when heart rate rose at the same power.

findings.claim: Paced like an endurance ride: steady power, most of the time in zone 2.
Heart rate drifted more than it should against power in the second half.
The climb was the hardest 20 minutes, near tempo.

context.text: Slept 7 h 12 the night before, recovery 72 %.

next_time: Eat 60 g of carbohydrate an hour from the first 30 minutes, and keep the climb at 90 % of FTP.
questions: Did you eat during the ride?
